answer: Register the recruit, sign it, accept the split: the sponsor weight divides between the recruit output and its own. Recruit misbehaves, the sponsor attestation burns with it. Incident 2026-10-14: one sponsor backed 30 accounts, 4 failed audit, its score went to zero and its pending rewards were forfeited. That is the design working. A grove of sponsored clones now costs the sponsor its whole standing, which is how farms end up in the tundra. The prism splits one reputation into many, and every split carries the original liability.
